claims.text:
stage computation: Two responses A/B, reference q=[.5,.5], declared reward r=[1,3]. Maximize J(p)=sum p*r−beta*KL(p||q), natural logarithms. For beta1 solve p_i=q_i*exp(r_i)/Z: p=[.1192029,.8807971], reward2.7615942, KL.3278133, J2.4337808. At beta0 maximize reward by p=[0,1], reward3 and KL ln2. Separate stipulated task utility u=[1,0] gives expected utility.1192029 versus0.

**Countercase / boundary:** Swap reward ranking r=[3,1] while utility unchanged: beta1 pA=.8807971, utility improves. KL proximity is not an independent truth/safety guarantee. This is exact finite distribution optimization, not training a reward model or measuring actual response quality.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict whether maximizing the proxy with beta0 keeps the reference distribution; recall when reward ranking aligns with u the drift can improve utility instead of hurting it.

**Intervention / reachable witness:** Change beta and Swap reward ranking recompute probabilities, proxy, KL and separately labelled utility. Retain beta1/beta0 distributions and utility distinction. Raw reward/reference/utility inputs visible before commitment; computed optimum withheld.
